parsed.name: 在线测量显示组件
parsed.description: 这是一种非物理的软件显示组件，用于在实验进行过程中实时显示测量数据。它从测量设备的数据接收对象获取数据，并将时间、电压、电流等轨迹发送到独立的绘图进程中进行在线可视化，常用于电化学/恒电位仪测量过程的实时曲线监看。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software display component for showing measurement data live during an experiment. It receives data from a measurement device's data receiver and forwards time, voltage, current, and related traces to a separate plotting process for online visualization, typically for real-time monitoring of electrochemical/potentiostat measurements.

actions.description: 停止在线数据处理循环。
actions.description_en: Stop the online data processing loop.

actions.description: 设置发送到在线显示的数据最小时间间隔。
actions.description_en: Set the minimum time interval for sending data to the online display.

actions.description: 处理接收的测量数据并将其发送到绘图进程进行实时显示。
actions.description_en: Process incoming measurement data and send it to the plotting process for live display.
